Subject: Internal: quick triage — Fintech Plus promo grant ingestion

Stephanie / Marissa — quick findings from the logs for signup anna.lowe@fintechplus.com (signup ts 2026-10-18T08:41:12-07:00):

1) Promo validation: the promo service validated code REDWOOD-PLG-60 at 08:41:13 and returned a grant record grant_id=GRANT-20261018-0923.
2) Grant dispatch: we attempted to enqueue a grant issuance event to the billing ingestion queue. The event was produced (event_id=evt-7f3a2b) but our ingestion consumer dropped the event due to a CRC mismatch while consuming a batch — appears to be an idempotency/offset handling edge case.
3) Reconciliation job: the nightly reconcile picks up missing grants and retries; however, because the event offset was marked as processed in the consumer state store, reconcile did not re-ingest. That's why ledger shows zero.

I attached a small extract (ledger_event_extract.csv) with the relevant event rows and their offsets.

Immediate remediation we recommend:
- Manual grant: create a manual grant tied to GRANT-20261018-0923 so the UI and ledger show available credit immediately.
- Short-term patch: force a re-run of the ingestion consumer for offsets range 45218-45220 to pick up evt-7f3a2b. I'll coordinate with infra to run this outside business hours if OK.
- Long-term: add an extra idempotency guard and CRC validation to the producer-consumer handshake; schedule a runbook.

I'll proceed to generate the manual grant if Stephanie approves.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Promo credits applied at signup not showing in dashboard — Grant issued

Hi Anna — quick update and sorry again for the delay.

What we did:
- Manually applied the grant that was generated at signup (grant_id=GRANT-20261018-0923). You should now see a +$60 promo credit in your account balance and the dashboard usage/available credit will reflect it.
- Dev has scheduled a re-run of the ingestion consumer for the affected offset range; if you re-export the ledger it should now include event evt-7f3a2b.

Why this happened (short): an ingestion consumer offset handling bug caused a properly-produced grant event to be dropped and the nightly reconcile didn't pick it up because the consumer offset state marked the batch as processed. Dev is putting together a patch and a runbook so this won't recur.

Action items for you:
- Please confirm you can see the $60 credit in the dashboard and that you're unblocked for testing.
- If anything looks off, reply here and we'll escalate immediately.

Reference: HS: 982134 (your deal), Grant ID: GRANT-20261018-0923, Event: evt-7f3a2b

Thanks for flagging this — we'll follow up with a post-mortem once the patch is in.
